tokens: Public Function Compute ( dMin As Double , dMax As Double ) As ChartAxisScaleResult Dim dPower As Double Dim dScale As Double Dim localDMin As Double = dMin Dim localDMax As Double = dMax If localDMax = localDMin Then dScale = localDMax localDMax = localDMax * 1.01R localDMin = localDMin * 0.99R End If If localDMax < localDMin Then dScale = localDMax localDMax = localDMin localDMin = dScale End If If localDMax > 0.0R Then localDMax = localDMax + ( localDMax - localDMin ) * 0.01R Else localDMax = localDMax - ( localDMax - localDMin ) * 0.01R End If If localDMin > 0.0R Then localDMin = localDMin + ( localDMax - localDMin ) * 0.01R Else localDMin = localDMin - ( localDMax - localDMin ) * 0.01R End If If localDMax = 0.0R AndAlso localDMin = 0.0R Then localDMax = 1.0R dPower = Math . Log ( localDMax - localDMin ) / Math . Log ( 10.0R ) dScale = Math . Pow ( 10.0R , dPower - Math . Floor ( dPower ) ) Select Case dScale Case 0.0R To 2.5R dScale = 0.2R Case 2.5R To 5.0R dScale = 0.5R Case 5.0R To 7.5R dScale = 1.0R Case Else dScale = 2.0R End Select dScale = dScale * Math . Pow ( 10.0R , Math . Floor ( dPower ) ) Return New ChartAxisScaleResult ( dScale * Math . Floor ( localDMin / dScale ) , dScale * ( Math . Floor ( localDMax / dScale ) + 1.0R ) , dScale ) End Function
